summary: BioPay V4 - Admin Audit Center, Terminal Diagnostics, FacePay Readiness, Advanced Fraud Scoring testing completed. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for Merchant Security tab and Admin BioPay Audit page.
seed_data_creation: Created BioPay terminal BIO-65A0C1B734 for testing. Approved merchant KYC via admin endpoint.

All backend endpoints working: fraud-summary, facepay-readiness, diagnostics (GET/POST), dashboard, admin overview, audit-center, terminal-diagnostics. No ObjectId serialization leaks. merchant_security_tab.details: Advanced fraud scoring data visible: network risk score, pending approvals, 24h session count, cashier risk list, terminal risk list, facepay readiness card, recommended next steps

biopay_diagnostic_write.details: Merchant can write diagnostic entry via API and see it in terminal diagnostic list. Terminal health/score data updated correctly.

facepay_readiness.details: FacePay readiness flags and guidance visible. FacePay feature flag correctly shows as disabled.

regression_check.details: Existing merchant security and BioPay flows still work. No regressions in tab rendering or route access.

kyc_gating.details: Merchant can reach Security tab after KYC approval. KYC gating working correctly.

objectid_serialization.details: No ObjectId serialization leaks or backend 500s on new audit/diagnostic routes.
